manual_image_review.note: Source identity, rights basis, crop role and later-representation caveats are explicit; previews were inspected and use no reconstructed imagery.

correctness_and_evidence.note: Official, reference, registry and object-catalogue sources are cross-checked; production-site and museum-site claims are separated.

coverage_and_completion.note: Standard profile has four image-ready collections, seven chronology anchors, one episode Story, six language entries, four reading tracks and 35 quiz questions.

editorial_quality.note: Forsvarsmuseet remains distinct from the fortress, castle, Resistance Museum and object production sites.

technical_integrity.note: Deterministic materializer, canonical manifests and a permanent targeted regression are included.

safety_and_responsibility.note: Wartime loss and military objects are handled without spectacle and with explicit source limits.

maintainability_and_auditability.note: Claims, source registry, chronology, image provenance, quiz brief and A–H report are inspectable.
